name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement the Deutsch-Jozsa algorithm in Qisk
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement the Deutsch-Jozsa algorithm in Qiskit for the balanced function f(x) = x_0 (the bit x[0]) on 3 input qubits. Print the measurement outcome and the conclusion. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
